title: AOS Live Use: Structured Action Logging
abstract: Using the upgraded AOS to log the actions from the previous tick.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')

from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 88

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    action_type="modify_code",
    target="aos_manager.py",
    metadata={"purpose": "Attempted bug fix"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    action_type="test_aos",
    target="adapter.py",
    metadata={"eval_id": 209, "status": "failed", "error": "KeyError: 'agent_id'"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    action_type="log_actions",
    target="tick_87",
    metadata={"eval_id": 210}
)

print("Structured logging complete.")
